description: This Java class 'EntityDataTableChecksTemplateData' is an immutable data transfer object used within the Apache Fineract project. It holds various lists and collections related to data query checks for entities such as clients, groups, savings, and loans. It is designed to be serialized and provides equality and hash code implementations based on its fields.

classes.name: EntityDataTableChecksTemplateData
classes.description: Immutable data object for storing entity data table check related information, including status data for different entity types and collections of product data.
